note:
Their own published feed, not their price table: bids.json sits beside index.html on badgergrain.com and their tooling writes both from the same numbers in the same run. schema emmert-cash-bids/2, carrying commodity, delivery month, basis and cashPrice.

identityAlternative: this feed carries no futures price and says so in its own terms -- "No exchange-licensed futures prices are included" -- so cash - basis = futures can never run on it. lib/board.mjs refuses such a source unless it names what it publishes on instead AND every row carries that stamp from the adapter. The three checks behind the stamp are in lib/adapters/emmert.mjs: their feed must say status "ok" (they withdraw their own price by saying otherwise), its `observed` stamp -- when THEY last read the board behind the price, which our checkedAt cannot see -- must be inside the 14-hour line in lib/freshness.mjs, and cash - basis must land inside the futures band for the commodity. futuresPriceCents publishes as null on every row: the implied quote is checked and dropped, because republishing it by subtraction is the one thing their terms decline to do.

Company, town, street address, ZIP and telephone are copied from their own site's published contact block on badgergrain.com. One office runs both this elevator and Midwest Commodity Service, which is why the two share a telephone number.

lat/lon is their own published street address geocoded by the US Census onelineaddress geocoder, benchmark Public_AR_Current, on 2026-09-21 -- the same service scripts/build_geocodes.py calls, so this is the answer that build would reach and not a second opinion. It matched "E5210 1040TH AVE, WHEELER, WI, 54772" on TIGER line 78984440, side R, and the geographies endpoint puts it in Dunn County. It sits 2.00 km from the centroid of ZIP 54772, inside the 50 km this repository allows between a yard and the middle of the town it is named for.

latPrecision is "street" and means it: a Census street match is interpolated along a TIGER segment, so it is the right side of the right road rather than a rooftop survey. geocodes/README.md measures 15-137 m between real facility pins and their own published addresses.

sameAsKnown names the Barchart directory rows for this same yard, by their exact key, so scripts/build_directory.mjs does not draw either as a second grey pin beside this one. Barchart lists them under a different telephone number from the office number the site publishes, so the phone rule can never join them. Declared 2026-09-21 at Sig's word.

UPDATE 2026-09-29: the piped key this used to declare ("Badger Grain Supply|Badger Grain Supply|Wheeler|WI") stopped matching when geocodes/places.json got re-keyed on 2026-09-23 -- known rows for this state now carry Barchart's own numeric facility id as the key instead of the piped shape (test/declared-same.test.mjs caught it, STATUS-2026-09-29). Re-pointed to that id, "1460", which survives a re-key the way a name-and-town string cannot. Also added "2573": Barchart lists Midwest Commodity Services Inc. under this same yard's location field ("Badger Grain", 20 m from this pin) -- the same shared office named two paragraphs up -- and it had never been declared at all, so it was surfacing as an undeclared second grey pin. Both ids were confirmed against geocodes/places.json known["1460"] and known["2573"] before this was written, not guessed.
publicNote: Their own posted cash bids, taken from the JSON feed they publish under CC0-1.0. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The feed carries no futures price and none is republished.
